name: HOB-RGPD
author: hoblucas

sections.description:
Work towards compliance with the Cookies and GDPR Legislation with HOB-RGPD, the new version of HOB Advanced Cookies.

HOB-RGPD allows you to give your users the choice to block the usage of non-essential cookies such as Facebook, X (Twitter), YouTube… It helps your site respect the GDPR.

HOB-RGPD is a complete rewrite of HOB Advanced Cookies. It blocks only the scripts and cookies of known services and never rewrites your page links.

What is GDPR?

The General Data Protection Regulation 2016/679 is a regulation in EU law on data protection and privacy for all individuals within the European Union and the European Economic Area. It also addresses the export of personal data outside the EU and EEA areas.

About HOB France Services

HOB France Services is a digital communication agency based in Sophia Antipolis and Paris. Our teams are true experts of WordPress projects. Website creation, maintenance, extension development and training, we support our customers in all phases of the realization of their digital projects.

As featured on

  • Assistance-WP
  • Support-WP
  • HOB FRANCE SERVICES

Features

  • Configurable consent banner (text, colors, position).
  • Per-service preferences grouped by category.
  • Clean blocking: third-party scripts are disabled until consent, without breaking other links.
  • Built-in, logo-rich catalog of 18 common services (Google Analytics, Facebook, YouTube, Vimeo, Instagram, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, TikTok, Google Ads, Google Maps, Cloudflare, Matomo, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, reCAPTCHA, Google Translate, Calaméo, Trizzy).
  • One-click scanner: detect the third-party services actually used on your site and enable only those.
  • Consent stored client-side and re-applied on each page load.
  • Fully translatable (English and French included).

Pro Version

Need even more possibilities than the free version offers? HOB-RGPD Pro is available on extension-wp.com. It lets you create your own services (scripts and cookies of any third-party tool) and edit the services of the catalog. The free version remains fully functional without it.

External services

This plugin does not connect to any external service. The service catalog and all logos are bundled with the plugin, and no data ever leaves your site.

The optional “Quick start” scanner loads pages of your own site (same domain) to detect which third-party services are present. It is triggered manually by an administrator and sends nothing to any third party.

Note: the plugin stores a list of third-party domains and cookie names (for example googletagmanager.com or _ga) in order to recognize and *block* those services on your pages. The plugin never contacts these domains; it only prevents your pages from doing so before consent.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for HOB-RGPD.
  3. Click Install, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the hob-rgpd folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How to use HOB-RGPD after installation?

In HOB-RGPD > Settings, you can customize the banner message, button texts, colors, banner position and privacy policy link.
In HOB-RGPD > Quick start, the scanner detects the third-party services used on your site and enables them.
In HOB-RGPD > Services, you can publish, unpublish or remove each service, and add more from the service catalog.

I already use HOB Advanced Cookies. How do I switch to HOB-RGPD?

HOB-RGPD is a separate plugin and does not import the settings of HOB Advanced Cookies. Deactivate HOB Advanced Cookies, then install and activate HOB-RGPD and set up your banner again; the Quick start scanner does most of the work. Do not keep both plugins active at the same time, or your visitors will see two banners.

Does HOB-RGPD modify my page links?

No. It only acts on scripts and cookies described in its service catalog. Your content links are never rewritten.

Does the plugin send data anywhere?

No. HOB-RGPD works entirely on your own site: no license check, no remote catalog, no tracking, no external request of any kind.
